servers.name: Document Translator gateway
servers.description: Translator status, cancel and capabilities. Translation itself runs through the Document Translator tool.

env.name: TRANSLATOR_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Gateway /mcp URL as reachable from the Open WebUI container, for example http://host.docker.internal:8766/mcp.

env.name: TRANSLATOR_API_KEY
env.description: Shared translator API key, sent as the bearer token. One key for every Open WebUI user.

servers.name: Employee directory
servers.description: Look up employees by name, nickname or id: email, position, manager, direct reports, management chain. Read only.

env.name: EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY_MCP_URL
env.description: Directory MCP endpoint as reachable from the Open WebUI container.

env.name: EMPLOYEE_MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Optional bearer key. Set it in .env and the directory then requires it on /mcp; leave it empty for no authentication.

servers.name: Mail drafts
servers.description: Draft email for the signed-in user. Cannot send: the user reviews the draft and presses Send in the Review and send email action.

env.name: MAIL_MCP_URL
env.description: Mail service MCP endpoint as reachable from the Open WebUI container.

env.name: MAIL_MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Shared key of the mail service model channel, sent as the bearer token. It can create and read drafts, never send.

servers.name: Employee directory (write)
servers.description: Create, update and soft-delete employees. Admin only. Needs the write instance of the directory (compose profile write) and its own key.

env.name: EMPLOYEE_WRITE_MCP_URL
env.description: MCP endpoint of the write instance, as reachable from the Open WebUI container.

env.name: EMPLOYEE_WRITE_MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer key of the write instance. The write instance refuses to start without it.
